source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 358 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 358 was established by Ordinance No. 21068, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 25, 1991. Ordinance No. 21068 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 358 is established on property generally located along the southwest line of Meyers Street, southeast of the southeast line of Ash Lane. The size of PD 358 is approximately 0.172 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Site And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.104. SITE AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the site and landscape plan (Exhibit 358A). (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.105. USES.

The only use permitted on the Property is a community service center. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Unless otherwise specified, the Property must be developed in accordance with the MF-2(A) district regulations contained in Section 51A-4.116. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking must comply with the site and landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.108. LANDSCAPING.

Landscaping must comply with the site and landscape plan. All landscaping must be installed in accordance with the provisions contained in Article X. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.109. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.110. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.111. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.112. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-358.113. ZONING MAP.

PD 358 is located on Zoning Map No. K-8. (Ord. Nos. 21068; 25850)
